summary: ```markdown # 【Marvelous Designer】Learning Day - Suit Set Production p05 FAQ ## Introduction In this session, we will discuss various aspects of suit set production using Marvelous Designer. We will cover technical adjustments, design principles, and address frequently asked questions regarding the software. ## Particle Diameter Adjustment Remember to adjust the particle diameter accordingly. I reduced the particle diameter of the pants. Is it like changing the magic? No, right? If you follow this step, it will be the final look in the video. ## Hat Production Regarding the hat, in the previous episodes, there was a live broadcast of making hats. It's not hard, everyone. I personally think the final effect is okay. You can follow me next Monday when I post this video. You can follow this video and these accessories to make the suit. ## Limited Edition Suit Paper Of course, if you have a limited edition of this suit paper, you can draw directly on it or go to our re-cut software. Alternatively, you can find it in the modular configuration. ## Men’s Jacket Design For the men's jacket, we can see that there are basically two single-line buttons. To import the ready-to-use suit, double-click to access it. This is a ready-to-use suit. ## Marvelous Designer (MD) Issues Do you have any problems with MD? It's not hard, but I should release the video next Monday. I don't know if you have found this menu; I actually put two cards here, which I will post on my website. ## Creating Button Effects If you want to create a button effect, you need to change some methods. If the button is always closed, it will be very influential. We will cancel it and remember it, then wait for it to be covered. ## Specific Spells in MD MD starts a specific spell, and it feels quite difficult. Sometimes, if you must have some very specific spells—for example, you must have a very vertical spell here—you need to know the starting point of this spell. ## Triangle Creation in MD For example, this point is the endpoint; the bottom two points should form a triangle here. However, in real life, after you make a triangle, this line may be blocked, and this shape may not match what you originally imagined. You may need to add some nails next to it, and at this time, I think you may just go directly to carving. ## Software Usage in the Game Industry Our software is widely used in the game industry, and many game companies utilize it. Generally, a lot of game companies start with a big shape first, as it takes time to start with a big shape in Marvelous Designer. ## Detailed Sketching with ZB If you must have some simple spells or specific spells, you have to go to ZB and do some detailed sketching. Doing animation calculation with a physical chain is personally not very convenient. ## Animation Considerations You should do the kind of animation where you pull the chain out. The chain is so long that it will affect the line because there is an action that needs to be pulled out. When the line is modified, it will impact your animation recording, and you may lose the animation you recorded before. ## Animation Related Content For more information about animation-related content, you can look at the animation entry or optimization videos I made previously. If you have any questions, please feel free to ask in the comments. ## Challenges with Physical Chains Yes, it's really hard to make a physical chain. My friend mentioned dragging socks, and in Marvelous 3D, the way of making socks differs from how people actually wear them. ## Flexibility in Marvelous 3D People's skin is flexible, but in Marvelous 3D, there are currently no flexible skin settings in our software. This setting is a bit difficult to achieve in real life. ## Suit Design Insights Looking at this suit, when you stand upright, you can't really feel the wrinkle effect. This is just an A pose, and there is no extra material. ## Understanding Wrinkles You see, the difference is significant because of the movement of the legs. These wrinkles can clearly indicate the texture of the pants and the suit. ## User Engagement I want to thank users who are interested in AMD and our software. Personal users or students can use various poses to create different clothing effects. ## Pose Optimization When you do an A pose, it doesn't show these wrinkles. You can change the movement of your legs to solidify these wrinkles. ## Shape Optimization Function For example, if you lean your whole body forward or bend your feet a little, you can use the shape optimization function to retain the wrinkles. ## Retaining Pleats If you have many wrinkles in an A pose, you can use these to solidify them. This model can then match the movements of some characters. ## Real-World vs. Game Realities Most games can't execute everything simultaneously due to computing limitations. It’s essential to adjust to the most common running posture to make it work efficiently. ## Practical Examples You can lift your leg gradually to avoid passing through the panel, and once it's well simulated, you will see the results. ## Pleating Techniques I have mentioned the pleating class before. For example, if I make line-shaped pants, I can create pleating by lifting the leg a little. ## Segmental Shape Optimization Use segmental shape optimization to retain pleating after returning to the normal A pose. ## Final Thoughts Remember, regardless of how loose your pants are, if you want obvious pleats, especially around the hip, it needs to be tight. ## Questions and Support If you have questions about using Marvelous Designer, feel free to ask. After changing the movement, the shape of the pants should still look good. ## Women’s Clothing Tutorial I previously had many episodes focusing on women's clothing, but now people ask me about men’s makeup. ## Conclusion This live broadcast aimed to clarify how to adjust according to your model size and address issues encountered with multi-layer structures in suit design. Thank you for your support, and don’t forget to follow our live broadcast room and Bilibili account for updates. ```
